scope: single CPU tree traversal, common verification simplifications, homogeneous-temperature sampler and T0 support; no root/tree scoring or KV policy changes
datasets: saved 480 first-turn inputs, six groups of 80; not all original dataset rows or fresh holdout
acceptance: Preserve T>0 conditional proposal law; T0 own-target argmax. Full480 before/after plus component profiles. No guarantee of bitwise AR equivalence in fp16.
baseline_adapters: identical AMD dtype, SHM/safe teardown, prefix lookup off, bounded request groups, exclude cap/clipped/tail steps from both numerator and denominator
measurement: two reversed-order tree process pairs, one chain pair; profile runs excluded from TPS claim; prompt bootstrap conditional on run pair
